english: end, conclusion, expiration
notes: text: ただ今をもちまして第4次試験は終了となります — the 4th phase exam is hereby concluded

english: examinee, exam candidate
notes: text: 受験生のみなさんすみやかにスタート地点へお戻り下さい — all examinees, please return promptly to the starting point

english: promptly, without delay, swiftly
notes: text: すみやかにスタート地点へお戻り下さい — please return promptly to the starting point

english: the grace period allowed to make it back (lit. return grace-period time)
notes: text: これより一時間を帰還猶予時間とさせていただきます — from now, we will allow one hour as your grace period to return

english: failing, not passing (an exam)
notes: text: それまでに戻られない方は全て不合格とみなします — anyone who hasn't returned by then will be deemed to have failed

english: invalid, null and void
notes: text: スタート地点へ到着した後のプレートの移動は無効です — moving plates around after reaching the starting point is invalid

english: disqualification
notes: text: 確認され次第失格となります — as soon as it's confirmed, it results in disqualification

english: newcomer, rookie
notes: text: 9人中6人が新人か — 6 out of 9 are rookies, huh

english: a bumper crop; figuratively, a banner year for promising newcomers
notes: Chairman Netero chuckling about this year's exam applicants: ほっほっほ 豊作 豊作

english: promising, full of promise
notes: text: 突然わっと有望な若者が集まりよる — suddenly a whole crowd of promising young people gathers

english: a successful candidate, someone who passed
notes: text: 新人の合格者が3人も出ない時期が続く — stretches where fewer than 3 rookies pass in a year

english: a duel
notes: text: 一風変わった決闘をしてもらうつもりじゃ — I intend to have you all fight a rather unusual duel

english: a bit unusual, peculiar, offbeat
notes: text: 一風変わった決闘をしてもらうつもりじゃ — I intend to have you fight a rather unusual duel

english: finally, at long last
notes: text: いよいよ最終試験だな — the final exam is finally here

english: something seems off/strange about someone's manner or condition
notes: text: 合流した時の様子が少しおかしかったのが気になってな — the way he seemed a bit off when we regrouped is bugging me

english: to be on one's mind, to bother/worry one, to be curious about
notes: text: 様子が少しおかしかったのが気になってな — the fact that he seemed a bit off is bothering me

english: to tail, to shadow, to secretly follow
notes: text: オレも他のヤツに尾けられててさ — I got tailed by some other guy too (passive: 尾けられて)

english: a poisoned arrow
notes: text: 毒矢にやられて — I got hit by a poisoned arrow

english: to take back, to reclaim (something that was stolen)
notes: text: ヒソカがそいつから奪い返した自分のプレートを — his own plate that Hisoka had taken back from that guy

english: to retaliate, to get back at someone, to hit back
notes: text: やり返せなかった自分自身が すごくくやしくて — being unable to get back at him made me really frustrated with myself

english: frustrating, vexing, galling (a feeling of regret at one's own failure)
notes: text: やり返せなかった自分自身が すごくくやしくて — I was so frustrated with myself for not being able to get back at him

english: to knock flying, to punch/slug hard (casual/rough speech)
notes: text: いらないって言ったらぶっとばされて — I said I didn't want it and got sent flying (passive: ぶっとばされて)

english: terribly, uncontrollably, for no particular reason
notes: text: その後なんか無性に情けなくて淋しくなってきて — afterward, for some reason, I felt terribly pathetic and lonely

english: pathetic, pitiful, shameful (of oneself)
notes: text: なんか無性に情けなくて淋しくなってきて — I started to feel terribly pathetic and lonely

english: to be insufficient, to be lacking
notes: text: 自分の力が不足してるような気がして — I felt like my own strength was lacking

english: to be useful, to be of help
notes: text: だから誰かの役に立ちたく なった…のかな — that's why I guess I wanted to be useful to someone

english: to search all over for, to look everywhere for
notes: text: それで2人を探しまわったんだ — so I searched everywhere for the two of you

english: to feel/express gratitude, to thank
notes: text: 本当に感謝してる — I'm truly grateful

english: an interview, a face-to-face meeting
notes: text: これより会長が面談を行います — the chairman will now conduct interviews

english: examinee number, candidate number
notes: text: 受験番号44番の方 おこし下さい — examinee number 44, please come this way

english: reception room, parlor
notes: text: 第1応接室までおこし下さい — please make your way to reception room 1

english: to have nothing to do with, to be unrelated
notes: text: まあ全く関係がないとは言わんが — well, I won't say it's completely unrelated

english: a qualification, a license
notes: text: 資格を持ってると色々便利だから — because having the license is handy for all sorts of things

english: exemption from liability, immunity from responsibility
notes: text: 免責になる場合が多いしね — because it often grants you immunity (e.g. Hunter License covering acts like killing)

english: hard to give up, hard to part with
notes: text: 405番も捨てがたいけど一番は彼だね — 405 is hard to give up too, but he's the top pick

english: a friendly match, a bout, crossing swords with someone
notes: text: いつか手合わせ願いたいなァ — I'd like to have a match with you sometime

english: well done, thanks for the trouble (old-fashioned/dialectal register)
notes: Chairman Netero's archaic speech pattern (じゃ instead of だ); text: うむ 御苦労じゃった さがってよいぞ — right, well done, you may step down

english: to have the wind taken out of one's sails, to be disarmed/deflated by someone
notes: Idiom; text: まるでスキだらけで毒気ぬかれちゃったよ — he was so wide open it completely deflated me

english: crafty, sly, not to be underestimated (lit. "can't be eaten/pinned down")
notes: text: くえないジイサンだな — what a crafty old man

english: as far as one can see/tell, from what's visible
notes: text: 見る限り一番バランスがいい — from what I can see, he's the most well-rounded

english: to catch one's eye, to stand out, to be noticeable
notes: text: 44番だいやでも目につく — number 44, he stands out whether you like it or not

english: to be no match for, unable to compete with
notes: text: 正直戦闘では敵わないだろう — honestly, he'd be no match in a straight fight

english: in a good sense, in a good way (as opposed to a bad way)
notes: text: いい意味で405番悪い意味で44番 — 405 stands out in a good way, 44 in a bad way (contrasted with 悪い意味で)

english: a debt of gratitude, a favor owed
notes: text: 405番だな 恩もあるし合格して欲しいと思うぜ — it's 405 for me — I owe him one too, so I want him to pass

english: dangerous, risky, "bad news" (casual slang)
notes: text: とにかく一番ヤバイしな — anyway, he's the most dangerous one, no question

english: a combination, a pairing or match-up (e.g. a tournament bracket)
notes: text: 組み合わせができたぞえ — the match-ups are ready

english: to be lopsided, skewed, biased
notes: text: 思ったより偏ったのォ — it ended up more lopsided than I expected (about the bracket)

english: triumphantly, officially, at long last (with pride or relief)
notes: text: 晴れてハンターの仲間入りじゃ — you'll officially join the ranks of Hunters

english: joining the ranks (of), becoming a member (of a group)
notes: text: 晴れてハンターの仲間入りじゃ — you'll officially join the ranks of Hunters

english: dead serious, totally serious (slang intensifier of マジ)
notes: text: 大マジじゃ — he's dead serious
